shell.subtitle: The editing engine now uses a workbench shell to host runtime governance, workspace browsing, document preview, and future editing domains on top of the new ecosystem.
shell.loadingDescription: Loading the active theme, locale, plugin context, and preferred layout.
shell.heroTitle: The editing engine workspace flow is moving into the new ecosystem
shell.heroDescription: This screen now includes workspace document sessions, a resource tree, a formal settings registry, and card preview support. Editor panels, command flows, and autosave will be added on top of this foundation.

metrics.themeReady: The theme chain is active through Host runtime.
metrics.themeFallback: The active theme is not visible in the current list, so the shell is using the runtime snapshot.
metrics.capabilitiesDescription: Current platform capability switches exposed by Host to the editing engine.

runtime.layoutDescription: The preferred workspace layout is governed by runtime config and persists immediately when changed.
runtime.localeDescription: Locale changes call i18n.setCurrent and re-render immediately at runtime.
runtime.versionDescription: The running plugin version from Host plugin context.
runtime.environmentDescription: Platform info from platform.getInfo that will drive future window, file, and interaction governance.
runtime.openDocumentCountDescription: The number of card or box documents currently loaded into this workspace session.

workspace.noRecentTargets: No recent target has been stored yet.
workspace.sidebarDescription: Browse the active workspace structure and return to recently handled documents.
workspace.repositoryEmptyDescription: Once you open a card or box file, the editing engine builds a formal workspace browser from its containing directory.
workspace.recentTargetsDescription: Recent targets are recorded automatically after documents enter the workspace session.
workspace.previewDescription: The preview stage hosts the current document view and will later become the main anchor for editing panels.
workspace.previewEmptyDescription: Open a card or box file to render the formal preview and document tabs here.
workspace.emptyDescription: Open a card or box file to restore the legacy editing experience inside the new Chips runtime.

inspector.description: The inspector surfaces document, session, and runtime details for future editing and command-domain migration.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Switch the interface language and re-render formal copy immediately.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: Inspect the formal summary of plugin, platform, and session context.

aria.previewSplit: Editing engine preview and inspector split view

editor.saveSucceeded: Saved back to the card file

layoutDescriptions.infiniteCanvas: Designed for spatial creation with free placement, drag orchestration, and canvas-first exploration.
